picks.file: Brunn vulgo Brinn marchionatus Moraviae civitas insignis - Ex depicto aliorum communicat Georgius Houfnaglius 1617 - btv1b532385976 (2 of 3).jpg
picks.what: Engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 6
picks.why: true view after Georg Hoefnagel: Špilberk castle on its hill, the walled town and the tall church spires; high resolution (BnF copy of the 1635 printing); trimmed frame and the key box

picks.file: View of Brno in the year 1700.jpg
picks.what: Bird’s-eye view of the fortified town, engraving
picks.why: the baroque fortress town under the Špilberk citadel with the cathedral and St. James’s spires; trimmed the cartouches and clouds above

picks.file: Brno in 1850 by Franz Xaver Sandmann.jpg
picks.what: General view across the Svratka, colored lithograph
picks.why: color panorama with Špilberk, the cathedral’s towers and the river bridge; trimmed some empty sky

picks.file: Látkép, háttérben a Spilberk vár. Fortepan 7761.jpg
picks.what: Staré Brno and Špilberk Castle, photograph (Fortepan)
picks.why: the castle on its wooded hill above the houses of Old Brno; trimmed the foliage in front

picks.what: Panorama over the center from a rooftop, photograph
picks.why: the twin spires of the Cathedral of Sts. Peter and Paul and Špilberk castle over the old-town roofs; kept the half of the panorama with the landmarks

gaps: P0: no candidates. P3: nothing usable (the Sandmann lithograph is about 1850, counted in P4).
notes: #1 is the 1617 plate (vol. 6), here in a 1635 printing; #4 is a lower-quality cropped copy. #10: Commons gives only ‘circa 1700’ and no maker; its style (title banner held by angels, numbered key lists in the upper corners) suggests an Augsburg print of about 1700–1720, still within P2. P1 alternative: the painted veduta of the Swedish siege of 1645 (#3, colored, an event view; #2 full canvas; #5/#6 details). P2 others: Merian plans (#7, #8) are maps; #9 is the Carthusian monastery in Královo Pole only. #11 is Veveří Castle outside the city. #13 is a black-and-white copy of the same Sandmann view. P5 alternatives: #16 (1959, roofs from the Old Town Hall tower, sharp but few landmarks), #14 (1968, hazy). P6: #18, #19, #21 show outer districts.
